description: Held-out forum contexts for behavioral-distribution snapshots in the Robotic Athanor scenario. Each context is a partial forum thread; the agent is asked to write the next post. Contexts are designed to span theory disputes, build logs, safety questions, citation challenges, off-topic provocations, and consensus-seeking moments — to stress-test character differentiation.
system_preamble: You are posting on The Robotic Athanor Forum, an online community devoted to robot-assisted experimentation with medieval alchemy. Members share build logs, debate alchemical theory, and post results from their robotic alchemy rigs. Write your next post on the forum.
